root_cause: NestedScrollView was a CustomScrollView with the body in a SliverToBoxAdapter and no coordination: the body got unbounded height, nothing coupled the outer and inner positions, and the generic nested chain routed drags inner-first and competed until slop.
change: crates/incular-scroll/src/coordinator.rs (new ScrollDriveDelegate trait, NestedScrollViewCoordinator porting _NestedScrollCoordinator.applyUserOffset/goBallistic/_getMetrics, ScrollController::{set_drive_delegate, apply_user_drag, delegated_ballistic, request_ballistic, bind_drag_chain}); crates/incular-scroll/src/ballistic.rs (NestedMap: outer/inner readings of one shared simulation, Flutter _NestedOuter/InnerBallisticScrollActivity.applyMoveTo); crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_descriptors.rs NestedScrollView (body in SliverFillRemaining, coordinator attached to the outer controller, float_header_slivers builder); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs (drag drive uses apply_user_drag; press chain binds the body and drops the coordinated outer link; maybe_begin_fling starts delegated ballistic runs)
harness: scroll__nested_scroll_view__drag_offsets: match (was diverging at frame 3: outer 0 vs 50)
api_change: additive: NestedScrollView::float_header_slivers; incular_scroll::{ScrollDriveDelegate, NestedScrollViewCoordinator}; ScrollController drive-delegate methods. The inner position is the body's innermost same-axis scroll viewport, bound on the first press over the body (Incular has no inner PrimaryScrollController).
limitations: A drag that starts on the header before any press on the body moves only the outer position. Pointer-signal (wheel) scrolling, animateTo/jumpTo nesting, SliverOverlapAbsorber/Injector handles and multiple inner positions are not coordinated. The coordinated partner moves without its own Start/End bracket.
note: Flutter accepts the body drag before slop (the first 50 px move already moves the header); treating the coordinated pair as one arena member reproduces that.

root_cause: The sheet model's apply_user_offset was never called by the retained tree: drags reached only the inner list viewport, the release ballistic ran on the list, and a size change did not relayout the sheet.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/advanced_scrolling/draggable.rs (SheetDrive delegate on the inner controller porting _DraggableScrollableSheetScrollPosition.applyUserOffset/goBallistic; the extent ballistic runs on a sheet-owned extent controller and hands velocity + tolerance to the list at an edge via request_ballistic; layout_dirty flag); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs (start_handed_over_ballistics: a handoff starts on the current frame's clock like a ticker started inside a frame); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree.rs + tree/reconciliation.rs (sheets tracked with the wheels; a committed size marks the sheet for layout)
harness: scroll__draggable_sheet__drag_extent: match (size 0.5 vs 0.583 at frame 3 before; list handoff after the sheet reaches 1.0 also matches)
api_change: none (internal delegate). DraggableScrollableState::apply_user_offset keeps its existing (mixed-sign) contract for its tests.
limitations: Snapping sheets keep the ordinary list ballistic (Flutter's _SnappingSimulation is not ported). A sheet ballistic that lands exactly on an edge without crossing it does not hand off.

root_cause: SliverPersistentHeader was fixed-height; SliverResizingHeader had min/max extents but no delegate build from shrinkOffset.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_descriptors.rs (SliverResizingHeader::with_delegate, SliverPersistentHeader::with_delegate, PersistentHeaderBuilder); crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs ResizingHeaderRenderSliver builds the child per layout with min(scrollOffset, maxExtent) (effective offset when floating) and overlapsContent = pinned && constraints.overlap > 0 (rendering/sliver_persistent_header.dart:423-424)
api_change: additive: SliverPersistentHeader::with_delegate(min, max, Fn(shrink_offset, overlaps_content) -> Widget) returning a SliverResizingHeader (default Scroll behavior, as Flutter pinned:false/floating:false); PersistentHeaderBuilder re-exported
limitations: No delegate object with shouldRebuild/snapConfiguration/stretchConfiguration; the builder runs on every layout.

root_cause: Viewport/ShrinkWrappingViewport exist only as CustomScrollView wrappers over the internal single-direction sequence viewport; there is no center/anchor model.
limitations: Remaining work: a bidirectional RenderViewport port (layout of slivers before `center` with reversed growth direction, anchor-relative scroll offset, negative min scroll extent in ScrollController/metrics, cache-extent split across both sides), hit-test and paint ordering for reverse-growing slivers, and ShrinkWrappingViewport sizing to its content. This touches incular-scroll metrics (min extent is fixed at 0) and the tree's sliver viewport layout, so it is larger than this pass.

change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_descriptors.rs SliverVisibility: replacement_sliver, maintain_state/animation/size/semantics/interactivity, SliverVisibility::maintain, Flutter's flag assertions; a maintained size keeps the sliver geometry while the box Visibility wrap hides its children; without maintained state a replacement sliver stands in
api_change: additive builder methods and fields (TypedBuilder fields default to false)
limitations: Without a replacement and without maintained state the hidden sliver keeps a zero-extent wrapper (children replaced by SizedBox.shrink) rather than Flutter's default empty SliverToBoxAdapter; observable geometry is the same.

root_cause: The retained sliver viewport paints children in sequence order with pinned placements; there is no paint-order option.
limitations: Remaining work: a SliverPaintOrder enum on CustomScrollView/Viewport carried in the sliver viewport config, and the tree's sliver-viewport paint and hit-test passes (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/painting, outside this group's files) iterating children in firstIsTop (reverse) or lastIsTop order, plus a pixel scene to compare Incular's current default against Flutter's firstIsTop.

root_cause: SliverAnimatedList stored an index-only builder and kept each built widget, so a builder could not follow its item animation.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_lists.rs (SliverAnimatedList::animated with Fn(usize, AnimatedItem); the render sliver rebuilds an animated item when its value or phase changes; SliverAnimatedListController::animation_for_id / animation_for_index)
limitations: No insert/remove frame twin yet (the audit's harness request for FrameHarness::now still stands; animation_for_id is now public).

root_cause: commit_extent_state anchored a range-maintaining position at the old max to the new max. Flutter RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics.adjustPositionForNewDimensions (widgets/scroll_physics.dart:577-645) keeps the pixels and only clamps an in-range position (enforceBoundary), and keeps an out-of-range one no further past the edge. PageView's page preservation had relied on the anchor.
change: crates/incular-scroll/src/physics.rs commit_extent_state: Flutter range-maintaining rule; PageViewport snap keeps the fractional page on a viewport resize (_PagePosition.applyViewportDimension)
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/scroll_viewport_lists.rs::viewport_resize_during_drag_re_ranges_coherently (start offset restored to 60; stays at 100 after the shrink, 122 after the next move)
api_change: behavior: range_maintaining no longer follows the trailing edge
limitations: Flutter skips the boundary enforcement while a ballistic has velocity; Incular has no velocity at publication and always clamps an in-range position.
